name: GUI
author: Dairymen Soft

provenance.note: Earlier than both registered GUI builds (1.61 and 2.10); its banner calls itself a beta. Found inside a disk magazine issue rather than a GUI distribution. 46 of its 48 names are in 1.61.
provenance.redistribution: Uploaded to Aminet, whose terms require the submitter to state distribution conditions. Kept as a fixture for identification and reference only.

findings: 48 keywords against 204 in 2.10, so the library grew fourfold after this. Explains three corpus programs at slot 24, two of which are `AP_GUI/master.AMOS` and its `slave.AMOS`, an AMOS-to-ARexx bridge by ahapp@top.monad.net that extscan resolves to this identity exactly off its token ids. DOCUMENTED AFTER ALL. `AMOSPro_GUI.Doc`, 18,308 bytes, sits in the corpus beside a library byte-identical to this fixture (sha a4ffb518…), and its banner reads “AMOSPro GUI Extension / > BETA VERSION 1.5 < / - FREEWARE - / ©1995-1996 Dairymen Soft”. That is where the author comes from; this row recorded ‘unattributed’. `AMOSPro_Images.Doc` ships with it. It documents 1.5 only; 1.61's own guide ships with the 1.62 build.
notes: Beta of the GUI extension: Intuition-style windows, gadgets and menus, and the only release with a plain-text manual rather than an AmigaGuide one.
